correctness.rationale: The bulk backward-generator equations for up/down/horizontal velocities were checked independently by exact rational substitution at 41 positions; entering at a wall in the inward state gives E[B]=2W/v and the stopped horizontal velocity-corrector martingale gives E[H²]=v²E[B]/lambda. For a random wall stay S, telegraph sign covariance exp(-beta|t-s|) integrates exactly to E[J²|S]=2 vbar²/beta [S-(1-e^{-beta S})/beta]. Independent, centered regenerating cycles of mean duration b+m and finite second time moment give D=(E H²+E J²)/(2(b+m)); this is the formula. Strict convexity of e^{-beta S}, Jensen, two-point increasingly variable laws and Laplace uniqueness establish the order, sharp bounds and identification. Independent algebra checks corroborated generator and Laplace identities. This depends on complete directional resetting, finite second moments and fixed positive beta; there is no extension to correlated wall histories or continuously oriented swimmers.

value.rationale: Wall residence variability at fixed mean is a concrete transport-control variable in confinement. Equal bulk occupation does not imply equal longitudinal diffusion, and the exact Laplace transform controls an experimentally relevant difference; sharp monotone distributional ordering and an inverse response curve are useful model-specific results. A non-Poisson extension was explicitly raised in the original model paper; the theorem answers it within clear idealized assumptions.

final_claim: For the specified four-direction run-and-tumble slit with iid finite-second-moment wall residence S and symmetric telegraph wall velocity, effective longitudinal diffusivity is a one-Laplace-value functional of S; at fixed mean, convex-order dispersion strictly increases it, deterministic residence minimizes it, a nonattained supremum exists, and the beta-curve identifies S.
limitations: Regenerative model, four cardinal directions and independent resetting only; beta,vbar strictly positive.
